scientific_integrity: Exact algebraic proof of the weighted optimum and finite spectral calculation, corroborated by a standard-library rational-arithmetic checker. Source comparison is a self-review and does not imply independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed 24-cell vertex set and degree-four spherical harmonic band; weighting optimum concerns all positive normalized node weights, not other vertex configurations. The earlier harmonic-design literature may contain unlocated applicable specializations. Independent audit not performed.
title: Fourth-band harmonic sampling on the 24-cell: exact spectrum and uniquely optimal weights
